name: Zelan
source:
Race: Female human
Origin: City of Light
Hobby: Collecting Crystalites
Job: Princess, traveller

The Princess of Holy Kingdom, Zelan travels with her friends to train herself and to collect powerful Crystalites. Her bright and cheerful outlook makes it easy to make new friends. 

First appeared in Zeiva's early game series - Genetic Glow.
